title: Example only — Salt Petrel
description: This is a fictional example advertisement for the Old Sea Dogs boats desk. Salt Petrel is not a real boat and is not for sale. She is described here only so the page can be reviewed with a bilge-keel cruiser lying at Hamble Point Marina.
